title: Garden project — spring plan
creator: Demo
text:
# A small garden, a fresh start

Turn the sunny corner into a **low-maintenance herb garden**.

## This weekend

- Measure the raised bed and sketch the layout.
- Pick up compost, basil, mint, and rosemary.
- Leave space for a stepping-stone path.

## Planting plan

| Plant | Where | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Basil | Sunny edge | Summer cooking |
| Mint | Separate pot | Keep it contained |
| Rosemary | Back corner | Evergreen structure |

> Start small. A useful garden beats a perfect plan.

## Next step

Make a shopping list before Saturday's market.

title: Garden shopping list
text:
## Saturday market

- Two bags of peat-free compost
- Basil and rosemary seedlings
- A terracotta pot for mint
- Gardening gloves and plant labels

Budget: **$45**. Check the shed before buying tools.

title: Garden ideas — a tiny herb bed
text: A narrow herb bed beside the kitchen door would make weeknight cooking easier. Use reclaimed timber, keep mint in its own pot, and add a little gravel path.

title: Garden notes — what worked last year
text: The garden did best with deep watering twice a week. Mulch kept the soil cool, basil liked the sunny edge, and rosemary needed less attention than expected.

title: Weekend plans
text: Saturday: visit the farmers' market, start the garden project, and try a new pasta recipe. Sunday: a long walk, a book, and dinner with friends.

title: Recipe — lemon & herb pasta
text:
## A quick dinner

Toss warm pasta with olive oil, lemon zest, a little parmesan, and fresh herbs from the garden. Finish with black pepper and a splash of pasta water.

title: Reading notes — The Secret Garden
text: The garden becomes a place for curiosity, friendship, and slow change. Favorite theme: paying attention to small things can change how a whole day feels.

title: Walking route — riverside loop
text: A relaxed 5 km loop along the river. Start near the old bridge, stop for coffee halfway, and return through the park. Best in the early morning.

# A little progress every day

A quiet morning, good coffee, and a clear plan for the week.

## Today

- Finish the herb garden shopping list.
- Take a walk before lunch.
- Make time for a chapter of my book.

## Small wins

The garden plan is finally simple enough to start. **One useful step** is better than another afternoon of planning.

> Leave a little room in the day for something unexpected.

## Evening

Try the lemon and herb pasta, then sketch the raised bed.
